SELECT hmr.*, (SELECT fe. NAME FROM fnd_org_unit fou, fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE fou.unit_id = hmr.unit_id AND fou.unit_id = fop.unit_id and fop.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fop.position_id = fea.position_id and fe.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and fea.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND fea.employee_id = fe.employee_id)project_manager_n, (SELECT max(fa.SOURCE_PK_VALUE) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faa, hls_report_attachment ha WHERE fa.ATTACHMENT_ID = faa.ATTACHMENT_ID AND faa.TABLE_PK_VALUE = ha.MARKETING_ATTACHMENT_ID and ha.ATTACHMENT_CATEGORY='HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_DOCX' and faa.TABLE_NAME = 'HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_DOCX' AND ha.MARKETING_REPORT_ID = hmr.MARKETING_REPORT_ID)SOURCE_PK_VALUE, (select f.company_short_name from fnd_company f where f.company_id = hmr.company_id )company_id_n, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' and hmr.insure_flag = v.CODE_VALUE)insure_flag_n, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'GUARANTEE_METHOD' and hmr.GUARANTEE_METHOD = v.CODE_VALUE)GUARANTEE_METHOD_N, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'PAY_METHOD' and hmr.PAY_METHOD = v.CODE_VALUE)PAY_METHOD_N, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL' and hmr.apply_leasing_products = v.CODE_VALUE)apply_leasing_products_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND hmr.credit_flag = v.CODE_VALUE)credit_flag_n, ( SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = hmr.created_by ) AS created_by_n, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = hmr.unit_id ) AS unit_id_n, TABALL1.NAME AS host_project_manager_n, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = hmr.host_unit_id ) host_unit_name, TABALL2.NAME AS assist_project_manager_n, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = hmr.assist_unit_id ) assist_unit_name, ( SELECT bank_name FROM csh_bank cb WHERE cb.bank_id = hmr.fall_bank ) fall_bank_n, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND code_value = hmr.whether_green_project ) whether_green_project_n, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.MARKETING_CHANNEL' AND code_value = hmr.MARKETING_CHANNEL ) MARKETING_CHANNEL_N, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.BRANCH_BANK' AND code_value = hmr.XY_BRANCH_BANK ) XY_BRANCH_BANK_N, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND code_value = hmr.FROM_PROJECT ) FROM_PROJECT_N, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.REVENUE_SHARING_BASE' AND code_value = hmr.REVENUE_SHARING_BASE ) REVENUE_SHARING_BASE_N, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND code_value = hmr.EXCLUSIVE_INDUSTRY ) EXCLUSIVE_INDUSTRY_N, ( select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = hmr.currency ) currency_n, ( SELECT wm_concat( hbm.bp_name ) FROM hls_bp_master hbm, HLS_MARKETING_REPORT_bp hmrb WHERE hbm.bp_id = hmrb.bp_id AND hmrb.marketing_report_id = hmr.marketing_report_id AND hmrb.bp_type IN ( 'TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC', 'ASSET_TRANSFEROR', 'ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE' ) ) as bp_name FROM HLS_MARKETING_REPORT hmr left join ( SELECT FE. NAME, SUA.USER_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, MIN(FOU.UNIT_NAME) UNIT_NAME, SUA.COMPANY_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FEA.UNIT_ID = FOU.UNIT_ID, ( SELECT MIN(COMPANY_ID) COMPANY_ID, USER_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION GROUP BY USER_ID ORDER BY USER_ID ASC ) SUAC, FND_EMPLOYEE FE WHERE SUA.COMPANY_ID = FEA.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = FOU.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = SUAC.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.USER_ID = SUAC.USER_ID AND FE.EMPLOYEE_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID GROUP BY SUA.USER_ID, SUA.COMPANY_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, FE. NAME ORDER BY SUA.USER_ID ASC ) TABALL1 on hmr.host_project_manager = TABALL1.USER_ID left join ( SELECT FE. NAME, SUA.USER_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, MIN(FOU.UNIT_NAME) UNIT_NAME, SUA.COMPANY_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FEA.UNIT_ID = FOU.UNIT_ID, ( SELECT MIN(COMPANY_ID) COMPANY_ID, USER_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION GROUP BY USER_ID ORDER BY USER_ID ASC ) SUAC, FND_EMPLOYEE FE WHERE SUA.COMPANY_ID = FEA.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = FOU.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.COMPANY_ID = SUAC.COMPANY_ID AND SUA.USER_ID = SUAC.USER_ID AND FE.EMPLOYEE_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID GROUP BY SUA.USER_ID, SUA.COMPANY_ID, FOU.UNIT_ID, FE. NAME ORDER BY SUA.USER_ID ASC ) TABALL2 on hmr.assist_project_manager = TABALL2.USER_ID
hmr.marketing_report_id = #{marketingReportId}

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT v.code_value_id AS tree_node_id, v.code_value_id, v.code_value AS value_code, v.MEANING AS value_name, v.parent_code_value_id AS parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING AS tree_node_desc, (case when v.code = 'HLS200.APPLY_LEASING_PRODUCT' THEN '' else 'N'end)expand_flag FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE V.CODE IN ( 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL', 'HLS200.APPLY_LEASING_PRODUCT' ) ORDER BY code_id ) t
1=1
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT v.code_value_id AS tree_node_id, v.code_value_id, v.code_value AS value_code, v.MEANING AS value_name, v.parent_code_value_id AS parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING AS tree_node_desc FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE V.CODE IN ( 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL', 'HLS200.APPLY_LEASING_PRODUCT' ) AND FIND_IN_SET( v.code_value_id, getChildList (v.code_value_id) ) ORDER BY code_id ) t
t.value_code not in ('GENERAL_CREDIT_APPROVAL','VENDOR_CREDIT_APPROVAL','UNION_CREDIT_APPROVAL')
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))
